votes.quote: january 6, 2025 on motion by fortin and second by proctor, the minutes were approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variance requests: 57 Round Road offset from 50 feet to 12 feet, and 73 Round Road offset from 50 feet to 22 feet.
votes.quote: on motion by proctor and second by emond, the board voted to approve the variance request on 57 round road from 50 feet to 12 feet and 73 round road from 50 feet to 22 feet.

votes.motion: Approve the deed restriction for the 2 bedroom septic system at 90 Youngs Road.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by proctor and second by emond, the 2 bedroom deed restriction was approved.

votes.motion: Deny the preliminary subdivision plan Pine Ridge Estates at 110 Burrage Street, based on potential residual contamination.
votes.quote: the subdivision plan was denied based on the potential residual contamination of the property.
on motion by proctor and seconded by fortin, the meeting was adjourned at 6:15 pm, all in favor.
